scope: Eight primary mechanism studies, plus two primary pathological-tremor contrasts. No clinical advice or novelty claim.

sources.authors: Vernooij CA, Lakie M, Reynolds RF
sources.title: The complete frequency spectrum of physiological tremor can be recreated by broadband mechanical or electrical drive
sources.access: Publisher abstract and main-text passages via web search
sources.evidence: Artificial input reproduced tremor peaks, including in two deafferented people.
sources.limit: Sufficiency of mechanical reproduction does not exclude neural contributions to natural tremor.

sources.authors: Halliday DM, Conway BA, Farmer SF, Rosenberg JR
sources.title: Load-Independent Contributions From Motor-Unit Synchronization to Human Physiological Tremor
sources.access: Author-institution repository abstract and publisher main-text passages
sources.evidence: Motor-unit and tremor recordings from 13 participants, with inertial loading.
sources.limit: Spectral coherence does not locate a unique causal neural source.

sources.authors: Jones KE, Hamilton AF de C, Wolpert DM
sources.title: Sources of Signal-Dependent Noise During Isometric Force Production
sources.access: Publisher abstract, main-text and table passages; author PDF indexed
sources.evidence: Voluntary, stimulated and mixed thumb contractions; five participants.
sources.limit: Motor-unit recruitment contributes to scaling; noise cannot simply be localized to a high-level command.

sources.title: Limb stiffness and postural tremor in the arm
sources.access: Complete indexed abstract only; full methods not inspected
sources.evidence: Voluntary stiffening during pointing increased finger tremor and reduced compensatory coupling.
sources.limit: Task-specific evidence against universal stiffening; not evidence that stiffness is always harmful.

sources.authors: Burdet E, Osu R, Franklin DW, Milner TE, Kawato M
sources.title: The central nervous system stabilizes unstable dynamics by learning optimal impedance
sources.access: Publisher abstract, figure captions and supplementary description; full main article subscription restricted
sources.evidence: Robotic divergent field elicited learned selective impedance geometry.
sources.limit: Planar experimental task does not imply arbitrary contact stability or globally optimal neural control.

sources.authors: Osu R, Burdet E, Franklin DW, Milner TE, Kawato M
sources.title: Different mechanisms involved in adaptation to stable and unstable dynamics
sources.evidence: Stable, divergent and rotated divergent fields distinguish adaptation patterns.
sources.limit: Inverse-model interpretation is inferred from behavior and EMG.

sources.authors: Crevecoeur F, Thonnard JL, Lefevre P, Scott SH
sources.title: Long-Latency Feedback Coordinates Upper-Limb and Hand Muscles during Object Manipulation Tasks
sources.access: Full primary article passages, methods, results and discussion
sources.evidence: Sixteen participants; goal-sensitive hand and shoulder responses at about 60 ms.
sources.limit: Sensory source split, fine contact dynamics and complete neural architecture remain unresolved.

sources.authors: van Beers RJ, Sittig AC, Denier van der Gon JJ
sources.title: Integration of Proprioceptive and Visual Position-Information: An Experimentally Supported Model
sources.access: Institution abstract and publisher methods/discussion passages
sources.evidence: Ten participants; hand localization under visual/proprioceptive conditions and prism shifts.
sources.limit: Perceptual estimation evidence does not establish hard sensor-error bounds or robust control.

sources.title: Non-invasive suppression of essential tremor via phase-locked disruption of its temporal coherence
sources.access: Full primary article including controlled intervention, results and limitations
sources.evidence: Eleven participants; double-blind phase-locked, active-control and sham comparisons.
sources.limit: Small intervention study; effective phase varies; detailed circuit mechanism includes modelling.

sources.authors: Helmich RC, Janssen MJR, Oyen WJG, Bloem BR, Toni I
sources.title: Pallidal dysfunction drives a cerebellothalamic circuit into Parkinson tremor
sources.access: Primary abstract, methods, results and interpretational-issues passages
sources.evidence: Imaging/EMG study of tremor-dominant and nontremor Parkinson groups and controls.
sources.limit: Authors explicitly state fMRI is correlational; apparent triggers may be reactive.

omitted_claims: All physiological tremor has one neural cause.
Essential tremor and Parkinsonian tremor share one proven mechanism.
Higher stiffness or feedback gain always improves steadiness.
Humans use one fixed minimum replan interval.
These experiments prove any robot arm can be made perfectly still.
The proposed energy or tracking certificates are new control theory.
